verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents webhooks as one of its outbound message channels (docs-43). Automations can be triggered when profiles perform events (docs-12), which implies event-driven outbound HTTP calls. Data-out integrations also push data to external platforms (docs-29). However, the evidence never describes registrable webhook subscriptions for platform events, such as delivery or engagement events, with payload or signing details. missing for 10: documented event-subscription/reporting webhooks, payload schema and event catalog, registration via API/CLI, signature verification and retry semantics, hands-on corroboration.
